note: Approved English city or locality of each club, for the second line of the team card header. Keys are the stable team catalogue ids of assets/teams.js (barcelona, real-madrid, ...). Each entry: { "city": "Madrid" } and, only when the display name cannot be split cleanly at the city (for example the city is not a trailing part of it), { "city": "...", "club": "approved short club name" }. A team with no entry shows its display name alone, with no second line. Empty until the 20 labels are approved.
